work.title: Define the improvement signal contract
work.description: Create a versioned derived output contract (codepatrol-improvement-signals, schemaVersion 1) with scope, works, returns, verification, baselines, execution, patterns, and observedAt.
acceptance: The contract is derived entirely from canonical state
Every signal contains supporting Work, attempt, or trace references
Absence of evidence is distinguishable from successful evidence
The contract contains no mutable recommendation state
Signal calculation is deterministic for the same repository state
